desc:
🎉 Chapter Two is out! All major bugs fixed.

Saigon After Nightfall is a horror experience set in the hidden corners of Saigon, Vietnam, a Vietnamese-atmosphere twist on traditional horror.

Chapter Một (1): Outbreaks of unidentified living hosts stalk the rain-soaked alleys of Saigon. Three teenagers investigate, only to be thrown into a spiral of terrifying events.

Chapter Hai (2): Hiding from the outbreak, the trio flee into a hospital. They soon learn that facing it outside would have been safer.

Inspired by Alex Kister's The Mandela Catalogue. Made by IDSTUDIOS.

Contact the team through the community servers below or the creator's profile (fy2_much).
